claim_boundary.addresses: coding-agent trajectory success/failure on public benchmark data

feature_families.cd: per-channel curvature summaries plus rolling variance and lag-1 ACF over windows 10 and 32

grouping.repository_group: full repository identity parsed from instance_id by removing only the terminal issue-number suffix

outcome.definition: linked repository tests evaluate the generated patch as resolving the issue
outcome.name: target

overall_rule: At least two of four prefixes must share a directional disposition; otherwise NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL.
prefix_horizon_limitation: Fractions are retrospective normalized horizons because final trajectory length is needed to locate the cut. They are not deployable clock-time thresholds.

primary_split.reason: prevents attempts from the same repository appearing in both partitions

question: Can observable structural features available in saved coding-agent trajectory prefixes predict independently verified final task success, and do Coherence Dynamics CSD features add held-out signal beyond simple churn baselines?

result_rule.BASELINE_EQUIVALENT: absolute PR-AUC delta <= 0.01 and interval includes zero
result_rule.BASELINE_OUTPERFORMS_CD: PR-AUC delta < -0.01 and grouped-bootstrap upper 95% bound < 0
result_rule.BLOCKED_DATA_NOT_MATERIALIZED: public trajectory bytes unavailable in execution environment
result_rule.CD_ADDS_HELDOUT_SIGNAL: simple+CD PR-AUC delta > 0.02, grouped-bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0, and ROC-AUC delta >= -0.005
